deployments_detail.use: TAIS Real Time generative-AI copilot assisting call center agents in real time; plus first Brazilian carrier with an app inside ChatGPT for plan queries and contracting

TAIS Real Time: generative-AI copilot that listens to and transcribes live customer-agent calls, infers customer intent, and proposes responses to call center agents in real time. Uses multiple fine-tuned LLMs. [Multiple LLMs (fine-tuned); vendor not fully named]
deployments_detail.value: Started with 60 agent positions in Rio de Janeiro; assisted ~1.5 million calls (Sept-Feb); double-digit % reduction in average handling time; reduced callbacks

deployments_detail.value: Since early 2023, 100% of support interactions use the personalized neural voice; 45 million calls processed in 2022; 400+ voices across 140 languages

deployments_detail.use: Rebuilt speech analytics platform for customer service, integrating Google transcription and multimodal Gemini models to turn customer call data into insights and drive continuous improvement. [Google Cloud (Gemini multimodal models, Speech-to-Text)]
deployments_detail.value: Reduced customer service improvement cycles from weeks to days

deployments_detail.use: Specialized AI agents across customer journey via Oracle AI Agent Platform, including 'Agente de Contas' (Account Agent) that compares invoices across months and explains variations to customers. Part of a five-year expanded Oracle contract. [Oracle (OCI, Oracle AI Agent Platform, Oracle AI Services)]
deployments_detail.value: 100+ AI use cases identified, 24 pilots, 7 in production; Account Agent reduced call handling time by 18% in pilot; AI copilot reduces response time up to 30%

TIM claims to be the first Brazilian operator to use AI in its network for predictive analysis. [Internally developed (TIM); expanding with Google generative AI]
deployments_detail.value: 85% prediction accuracy; 100% of access network infrastructure covered; 15% reduction in maintenance interventions
